title: Add failing tests that a signature-valid attestation whose command digest and attempt id match is stored, and that an invalid signature, a missing registry key, or a different attempt id is rejected with no evidence added. Implement Ed25519 verification over canonical JSON using `node:crypto` until `node --test test/verification-evidence.test.mjs` passes. Do not accept an import as red evidence.
